Enquiry call: bathroom renovation

For new enquiries from the website quote form · about 10 minutes · in your voice1
YOUR LOGO

OPEN12

G'day, it's [name] from [business]. Thanks for getting in touch about the bathroom. Got five minutes to run through it?

DISCOVER35
  • What's driving the reno: wear and tear, selling, or a whole new look?
  • How old is the bathroom? Any leaks or water damage you know of?
  • What's your timing, and is the room used every day?
  • Have you got a rough budget in mind?

GOODRefresh: new tapware, regrout, reseal
